sampling_algorithm: Identical to TRAIN_PROMPT_v1/TRAIN_ARCH_v1 except the candidate pool is restricted to documents used by NONE of the four prior manifests (document-level exclusion, by construction). Performance-agnostic: no model output, difficulty, or evidence property is read.
